newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end up on good sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end up on good sentiment.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended up on Wednesday on positive sentiment, with more investors seen buying in selective stocks after a year-high close for the B share index on Tuesday, brokers said.
The B index surged 1.975 points or 2.64 percent to 76.870 prices on heavy volume of 27.245 million shares worth $15.07 million, compared with $7.9 million on Tuesday.
Brokers said more follow-up buying emerged in the afternoon session with signs of volumes growing during the morning, pushing the index sharply up.
"Investors, especially domestic players, built positions actively today, indicating strong confidence in their outlook for the market," one broker said.
"The index will likely test resistance at 78-80 points in the short term," another broker said. "If that level is broken, it will spark more follow-up buying."
All 43 B shares traded, with 28 up, seven flat and eight down.
Shanghai Dazhong Taxi was the star performer on talk of financial restructuring, up $0.104 or 8.25 percent to $1.364 on volume of 831,400 shares.
Dazhong declined to comment on the rumors.
Inner Mongolia Erdos Cashmere Products was the most actively traded stock on institutional buying, gaining $0.022 or 2.69 percent to $0.838 on volume of 2.3 million shares.
The Shanghai A share index ended up slighly in active trading, but technical charts showed signs of a possibile downward correction in the short term, brokers said.
The index edged up 2.177 points or 0.16 percent to 1,391.929 points on volume of 889.2 million shares worth 10.9 billion yuan.
The SSE30 index dipped 3.101 points or 0.09 percent to 3,593.295 points.
Shanghai 3F New Materials was the star A share, surging 1.05 yuan or 10.03 percent to 11.51 yuan on volume of 5.9 million shares due to speculative buying.
